financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Registered direct offering of 740,000 shares at $4.35 (proceeds net of placement agent fee, before other expenses). The filings excerpted do not state the closing date, so 2024-05-23 is assumed from the filing date.

warrants.quote: The Common Warrants have an exercise price equal to $30.00, became exercisable commencing six months following issuance
The Placement Agents Warrants have an exercise price equal to $37.50, exercisable commencing six months following issuance
The Common Warrants have an exercise price equal to $4.35 and are exercisable immediately upon issuance
